bias.zh: 偏空 · 守住 9 月低点

read.en: SpaceX slipped 0.1% on Oct 20 to $147.79, trading between $143.27 and $148.66; with 90 sessions of history there is no 100-day average yet. It is below the falling 5-day ($148.5), rising 30-day ($153.3) and falling 10-day ($155.3) averages. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 14 and is above zero, with the histogram still widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 14 ($171.85), and RSI is 45.
read.zh: SpaceX 10月20日微跌 0.1%，收于 $147.79，盘中区间 $143.27–148.66；上市仅 90 个交易日，尚无 100 日均线。股价位于下行的 5 日（$148.5）、上行的 30 日（$153.3）和下行的 10 日均线（$155.3）下方。MACD 自 10月14日起位于信号线下方，仍在零轴之上，柱状图仍在扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月14日起看空（$171.85），RSI 为 45。

read.en: The low dipped under the $145.4 Sep 28 low, but the close recovered above it for a fourth session. Resistance is $148.5–148.7 (5-day, day's high), then $153.3 (30-day) and $158 (Sep 21 high). Support is $145.4, then $140.7 (Oct 15 low) and $130.4 (Aug 20 low). A close above $153.3 would target $158; a close below $140.7 would open $130.4.
read.zh: 盘中低点跌破 $145.4 的 9月28日低点，但收盘连续第四个交易日回到其上方。阻力为 $148.5–148.7（5 日均线、当日高点），其次 $153.3（30 日均线）和 $158（9月21日高点）。支撑为 $145.4，其次 $140.7（10月15日低点）和 $130.4（8月20日低点）。若收盘站上 $153.3，下一目标看 $158；若收盘跌破 $140.7，下一目标看 $130.4。
